response.justification: While Bogdan possesses strong hands-on expertise in building production-grade agentic AI infrastructure and robust distributed systems, which are critical technical components of this role, the resume lacks the executive-level leadership experience required for a CTO at a venture-backed scale-up. There is no evidence of scaling engineering organizations from 10 to 30+ people, developing senior technical leadership, or managing the governance aspects of a large engineering function, which are explicit hard requirements for this position.
strengths: Direct experience building production-grade agentic AI infrastructure and tooling.
Extensive background in backend, microservices, event-driven, and real-time distributed systems.
Demonstrated commitment to software craftsmanship and robust engineering practices over 10+ years.
concerns: Absence of senior technical leadership experience (e.g., VP Engineering, CTO) at scale-ups.
No track record of scaling engineering teams from 10 to 30+ or developing a leadership layer.
Limited explicit experience with AI systems in regulated fintech environments or specific AI-native fintech applications.
